g.text: How a Jitsi Call Is Established
From browser click to live video — step by step
Step 4A — ICE: Bob (SFR 5G) finds direct IPv6 path
Bob on SFR 5G DS-Lite (inbound IPv4 blocked at AFTR)
Step 4B — ICE: Alice uses Tailscale/LAN direct
Step 4C — ICE fallback for public IPv4 clients
It routes encrypted packets without decoding them.
Each participant's media stays end-to-end encrypted.
The server never sees the video content.
